seeds.script: A neighbor brought soup. We have been promoted to friends.
The key was in the bread box. Again. Everything is all right.
We own three brooms. Not one of them has swept the floor.
Nobody wanted the last pancake. So it stayed for breakfast.
The rooster started early. The hens voted to sleep in.
HUMKIN RADIO. There's an extra chair at the table. Pull it up.
The wood was wet. The fire took its time. So did we.
The kettle has boiled. The work can wait one more song.
Someone left the porch light on. Nobody asked who.
The hat was upside down. We wore it anyway.
The committee on sweeping has agreed to meet after the sweeping.
A meeting was held in the hayloft. The hay was absent.
We asked the goose for directions. It has declined to comment.
HUMKIN RADIO. Two mugs, one kettle, and a very long argument over who asked first.
The chairs voted on whether to move. The motion did not carry.
The ladder has been inspected. The inspector is still up there.
We held a contest for the best cake. The judges ate the results.
The eggs have been counted twice. The hens disagree.
The cow issued a formal apology. Nobody remembers what for.
The wooden spoon has resigned from the soup. It would like to stir elsewhere.
The barn has asked to be treated as a guest. It has always lived here.
The chair has requested a chair to sit on. We are considering it.
We found the missing day behind a sack of flour. It was still fresh.
HUMKIN RADIO. The boots have formed a union. They refuse to walk alone.
The committee on silence has made an announcement. It was well received.
The supper bell rang at breakfast. Everybody came anyway.
The fence has taken both sides of an argument. This is normal for a fence.
The moon sent the barn a bill for light. The barn requested a candle.
The wind has resigned. The hats have never been happier.
Tomorrow came by looking for bread. We told it to come back yesterday.
The north wind and the south wind shook hands. The house fell quiet.
HUMKIN RADIO. The mountain has been waiting for us. It says there is no hurry.
This chair has witnessed a thousand dinners. It remembers the pie.
The universe asked what we were making. We said supper. It stayed.
The stars planted a garden in the dark. The weeds look magnificent.
The king asked for riches. The cook brought soup. Nobody complained.
